Title: Azure Data Box Gateway now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Data Box Gateway is a virtual appliance that acts as a storage gateway and creates a link between your site and Azure Storage. This makes moving data in and out of Azure Storage as easy as working with a local network share. Just copy data to the local share, and Data Box Gateway will handle moving it to Azure Storage. It’s great for efficiently moving files in and out of Azure while retaining local access to your most recent files.

Learn more.
